title: Shared .png image URL falls back to placeholder redirect while export is pending
answers: Shared dashboard link shows no image in Slack/Twitter preview
What does /shared/<token>.png return before the export finishes?
Why is the fallback redirect Cache-Control no-store?
body:
In `posthog/api/sharing.py:retrieve`, the `.png` branch calls `get_content_response(exported_asset, False)`. If that raises `NotFound` (export not ready), it returns `HttpResponseRedirect(static("blank-dashboard-hog.png"))` with `Cache-Control: no-store`. This lets preview crawlers that hit the URL before the async export completes get an image, and the redirect is not cached, so the real export is served once ready.
Keep `no-store` on the fallback. Missing exported asset (`not exported_asset`) still raises NotFound.
Test: `test_shared_thing_uses_placeholder_while_open_graph_image_is_pending` in `posthog/api/test/test_sharing.py` (parameterized over insights and dashboards).
